interface: provisional local concentration helper; canonical uniformProb is imported unchanged
statement: For m>0 and f:(Fin m→Bool)→ℝ with |f(update x i b)-f x|≤1 for every x,i,b, and t≥0, uniformProb(f≤uniformMean f-t)≤Real.exp(-2*t^2/m).
proof_route: Uniform finite means are exact normalized sums. Split a Boolean cube through Fin.consEquiv. Induct on dimension to bound the centered MGF by exp(m*s^2/8). Slice means differ by at most one. Their two-point centered MGF is a cosh, bounded by Mathlib Real.cosh_le_exp_half_sq and the squared slice-mean gap. Pointwise exponential Markov yields a lower tail and the parameter s=4t/m gives the sharp exponent.
failed_approaches: Initial draft used reserved Lean token λ as a variable; renamed to s. No mathematical obstruction.
Zero-dimensional proof initially chose an explicit empty function while simp chose default; simplifying normalized sums directly solved the equality. No mathematical gap.
